question: For each term and department, list the term, department, the number of courses, average number of equivalent subjects, the school name, and department phone number. Include subtotals for each term (the corresponding term field is 'SUBTOTAL') and a grand total across all terms (the corresponding term field is 'TOTAL'). Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "subjects_offered" AS SELECT "term_code" AS "term_code", "offer_dept_code" AS "offer_dept_code", "offer_dept_name" AS "offer_dept_name", "offer_school_name" AS "offer_school_name", "subject_id" AS "subject_id", "master_subject_id" AS "master_subject_id", "cluster_list" AS "cluster_list" FROM beaver."subject_offered_summary";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "dept_directory" AS WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(department AS VARCHAR) AS department_code,
    CAST(department_name AS VARCHAR) AS department_name,
    CAST(office_phone AS VARCHAR) AS department_phone
  FROM beaver."mit_student_directory"
  WHERE office_phone IS NOT NULL
),
phone_rank AS (
  SELECT 
    department_code,
    department_name,
    department_phone,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_code, department_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, department_phone) AS rn
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY department_code, department_name, department_phone
),
most_frequent_phone AS (
  SELECT department_code, department_name, department_phone
  FROM phone_rank
  WHERE rn = 1
),
with_school AS (
  SELECT 
    m.department_code,
    m.department_name,
    COALESCE(sd.school_name, sd2.school_name) AS school_name,
    m.department_phone
  FROM most_frequent_phone m
  LEFT JOIN beaver."student_department" sd
    ON sd.department_code = m.department_code
  LEFT JOIN beaver."student_department" sd2
    ON sd2.department_name = m.department_name
)
SELECT 
  department_code,
  department_name,
  school_name,
  department_phone
FROM with_school

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name,
    offer_school_name,
    subject_id,
    cluster_list
  FROM subjects_offered
), equiv AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name,
    offer_school_name,
    subject_id,
    CASE
      WHEN cluster_list IS NULL OR TRIM(cluster_list) = '' THEN 1
      ELSE 1 + array_length(string_split(cluster_list, ',')) - 1
    END AS equiv_count
  FROM base
), per_dept AS (
  SELECT
    term_code AS term,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name AS department,
    offer_school_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_courses,
    AVG(equiv_count)::DOUBLE AS avg_equivalents
  FROM equiv
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    p.term,
    p.department,
    p.num_courses,
    p.avg_equivalents,
    COALESCE(d.school_name, p.offer_school_name) AS school_name,
    d.department_phone AS department_phone
  FROM per_dept p
  LEFT JOIN dept_directory d
    ON d.department_code = p.offer_dept_code
), ordered AS (
  SELECT * FROM joined ORDER BY term, department
), with_subtotals AS (
  SELECT * FROM ordered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    term AS term,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    (SUM(num_courses * avg_equivalents) / NULLIF(SUM(num_courses),0))::DOUBLE AS avg_equivalents,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS school_name,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department_phone
  FROM ordered
  GROUP BY term
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS term,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    (SUM(num_courses * avg_equivalents) / NULLIF(SUM(num_courses),0))::DOUBLE AS avg_equivalents,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS school_name,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department_phone
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT * FROM with_subtotals
ORDER BY CASE WHEN term IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, term, department;

WITH so_raw AS (
  SELECT columns FROM subjects_offered
), dd_raw AS (

    json_extract(columns, '$.subject_id')::VARCHAR AS subject_id,
    json_extract(columns, '$.cluster_list')::VARCHAR AS cluster_list
  FROM so_raw
), dd AS (
  SELECT
    json_extract(columns, '$.department_code')::VARCHAR AS department_code,
    json_extract(columns, '$.school_name')::VARCHAR AS school_name,
    json_extract(columns, '$.department_phone')::VARCHAR AS department_phone
  FROM dd_raw
), equiv AS (
  SELECT
    term_code,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name,
    offer_school_name,
    subject_id,
    CASE
      WHEN cluster_list IS NULL OR TRIM(cluster_list) = '' THEN 1
      ELSE array_length(string_split(cluster_list, ','))
    END AS equiv_count
  FROM so
), per_dept AS (
  SELECT
    term_code AS term,
    offer_dept_code,
    offer_dept_name AS department,
    offer_school_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS num_courses,
    AVG(equiv_count)::DOUBLE AS avg_equivalents
  FROM equiv
  WHERE term IS NOT NULL AND department IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    p.term,
    p.department,
    p.num_courses,
    p.avg_equivalents,
    COALESCE(d.school_name, p.offer_school_name) AS school_name,
    d.department_phone AS department_phone
  FROM per_dept p
  LEFT JOIN dd d
    ON d.department_code = p.offer_dept_code
), ordered AS (
  SELECT * FROM joined ORDER BY term, department
), term_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    term,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    (SUM(num_courses * avg_equivalents) / NULLIF(SUM(num_courses),0))::DOUBLE AS avg_equivalents,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS school_name,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department_phone
  FROM ordered
  GROUP BY term
), grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS term,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department,
    SUM(num_courses) AS num_courses,
    (SUM(num_courses * avg_equivalents) / NULLIF(SUM(num_courses),0))::DOUBLE AS avg_equivalents,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS school_name,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS department_phone
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT * FROM ordered
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM term_subtotals
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM grand_total
ORDER BY CASE WHEN term IN ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, term, department;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "dept_directory" AS WITH dept AS (
  SELECT department_code, department_name, school_name FROM beaver.student_department
), phone_prep AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(office_phone AS VARCHAR) AS office_phone_str,
    department AS department_code
  FROM beaver.mit_student_directory
  WHERE office_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(office_phone AS VARCHAR)) <> '' AND department IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(department) <> ''
), phone_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    department_code,
    office_phone_str,
    COUNT(*) AS freq,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, office_phone_str) AS rn
  FROM phone_prep
  GROUP BY department_code, office_phone_str
), phone_mode AS (
  SELECT department_code, office_phone_str AS department_phone
  FROM phone_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
), joined AS (
  SELECT 
    d.department_code,
    d.department_name,
    d.school_name,
    pm.department_phone
  FROM dept d
  LEFT JOIN phone_mode pm ON pm.department_code = d.department_code
), j AS (
  SELECT 
    '{' ||
    '"department_code":"' || COALESCE(department_code,'') || '",' ||
    '"department_name":"' || COALESCE(department_name,'') || '",' ||
    '"school_name":"' || COALESCE(school_name,'') || '",' ||
    '"department_phone":"' || COALESCE(department_phone,'') || '"' ||
    '}' AS columns
  FROM joined
)
SELECT columns FROM j

# Ensure final sort and term suppression are persisted
import pandas as pd
res = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, 'SELECT term, department, num_courses, avg_equivalents, school_name, department_phone FROM conductor_s_execution;')
res = res.sort_values(by=['term','department'], kind='mergesort', na_position='last').reset_index(drop=True)
last_term = None
for i in range(len(res)):
    t = res.at[i, 'term']
    if t not in ('SUBTOTAL','TOTAL'):
        if last_term == t:
            res.at[i, 'term'] = ''
        else:
            last_term = t
    else:
        last_term = None
from pandas import DataFrame
_tmp = DataFrame(res)
db_api.register_temporary_df(user_id, chat_id, _tmp, 'per_term_output_temp')
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, 'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS SELECT * FROM per_term_output_temp;')
